stemMd: A circle has radius 6. What is the length of its minor arc subtending a central angle of 120 degrees?
explanationMd: The angle is one third of a full turn. Take one third of the circumference 2π times 6 to obtain 4π.

distractorRationale.b: This takes one sixth rather than one third of the circumference.
